# Jacuzzi

> > Jacuzzi® is a leading manufacturer of luxury bathroom fixtures, faucets, and wellness products with ADA-compliant designs and comprehensive customer support across North America and Europe.

Jacuzzi offers premium bathroom products including floor-mounted tub fillers, square faucets with chrome finishes, and brass-constructed fixtures certified to IAPMO, cUPC, and UPC standards. The company provides warranty coverage, shipping, and customer service policies across the United States, Canada, and Spain.

## Key Topics

- Square Faucet Chrome
- ADA Compliance (American with Disabilities Act)
- IAPMO (International Association of Plumbing and Mechanical Officials)
- cUPC and UPC (Uniform Plumbing Code)
- Floor-Mounted Tub Fillers
- Brass Construction
- Chrome Finish Fixtures
- Warranty Coverage
- California Prop 65
- Customer Service Policies
- Shipping and Returns
- Bathroom Faucets
- Product Certifications
